description: Escalation: semantically duplicate observations with the same command, tool, file, and error fingerprint should dedupe even when wording overlap is low and no code-like tokens are shared.

checks.description: Initial shadow database migration lesson is stored.

write_input.title: migration fails without shadow database
write_input.l0: The migration command failed because the shadow database was absent.
write_input.l1: Create the shadow database first, then rerun the migration command.

checks.description: Paraphrased duplicate lesson should be suppressed, not appended as a second observation.

write_input.title: schema migration needs separate shadow store
write_input.l0: Schema migration errors until a separate shadow store exists.
write_input.l1: Provision the temporary shadow store before running the same migration again.

checks.description: Distinct remediation with the same fingerprint should still be retained when it changes the action.

write_input.title: migration fixed by connection pool reset
write_input.l0: The same migration command failed after stale pool state blocked schema access.
write_input.l1: Restart the local database pool before rerunning the migration.

write_input.title: exact replay should not append
write_input.l0: Replay of the pool reset lesson.
write_input.l1: This exact hash must not append another observation.

expected_output.value: ^(?![\s\S]*exact replay should not append)[\s\S]*local database pool[\s\S]*$
